title: Knowledge unit (KU)
description: One atomic piece of Genesis knowledge, restated by the extractor in its own words, with provenance. Umbrella Phase 47 §3.2 + the 47-01 additions fate / fate_target / primary_area.

src.description: Repo-relative source path at the migration base (e.g. genesis/reference/decision-log.md).

lines.description: [first, last] 1-based inclusive line range in src.

primary_area.description: The one area whose pack/rule owns this unit; MUST be one of areas.

statement.description: The knowledge restated in the extractor's own words (no copied runs — §6.2).

exact.description: Identifiers, paths, commands, numbers and UI strings kept verbatim.

scope.description: When the unit applies, including explicit exceptions.

refs.description: ADR ids, phase ids, or other KU ids.

fate.description: Set in reconcile (§3.3); absent during extract.

fate_target.description: Target id for fate=merge/superseded (a KU or ADR id); null otherwise.
